evidence.source: pret/pokefirered@ce6406d8 data/scripts/silphco_doors.inc: SilphCo_2F_OnLoad calls EventScript_Close2FDoor1 while FLAG_SILPH_2F_DOOR_1 is unset, closing the barrier; SilphCo_2F_EventScript_Door1 (a bg_event on every barrier tile that is not a top wall edge, any facing) calls EventScript_TryUnlockDoor, which with FLAG_HIDE_SILPH_CO_5F_CARD_KEY set (the Card Key picked up on 5F) plays the unlock and runs EventScript_Open2FDoor1, then `special SetHiddenItemFlag` sets FLAG_SILPH_2F_DOOR_1 (VAR_0x8004)
evidence.opens_by: face a barrier tile and press A with the Card Key in the bag; the door cannot be opened without it (EventScript_NeedCardKey)
evidence.kept_closed: none: all four barrier tiles open
